bottom_line: In the combined EURIDIS/ADONIS trials, dronedarone vs placebo reduced recurrence of atrial fibrillation at 12 months (hazard ratio, 0.75; 95% CI, 0.65 to 0.87).
implications: These trials support that dronedarone (400 mg twice daily) prolongs time to first recurrence and reduces the hazard of recurrence of atrial fibrillation vs placebo over 12 months (combined hazard ratio 0.75; 95% CI, 0.65 to 0.87) and is associated with lower ventricular rate at first recurrence; they do not establish comparative efficacy or safety vs amiodarone because "we did not directly compare dronedarone with amiodarone" and the authors note that not all arrhythmia episodes were detected.

major_points.text: Two identical multicenter, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trials evaluated dronedarone 400 mg twice daily vs placebo.
major_points.quote:
In two identical multicenter, double-blind, randomized trials, one conducted in Eu-
rope (ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT00259428) and one conducted in the United
States, Canada, Australia, South Africa, and Argentina

major_points.text: At 12 months in the combined analysis, recurrence rates were 64.1% with dronedarone vs 75.2% with placebo (hazard ratio 0.75; 95% CI 0.65–0.87; P<0.001).
major_points.quote:
At 12 months, the rates
of recurrence were 64.1% in the dronedarone
group and 75.2% in the placebo group (hazard
ratio, 0.75; 95% CI, 0.65 to 0.87; P<0.001)

major_points.text: Median time to first recurrence was longer with dronedarone than placebo in both trials (European: 96 vs 41 days; non-European: 158 vs 59 days).
major_points.quote:
the median times from
randomization to a documented recurrence of atri-
al fibrillation were 96 days in the dronedarone
group and 41 days in the placebo group.

major_points.text: Ventricular rate at first recurrence was lower with dronedarone than placebo in both trials.
major_points.quote:
In the European trial, the mean
(±SD) ventricular rate during the first adjudicated
recurrence was 102.3±24.7 beats per minute in the
dronedarone group and 117.5±29.1 beats per min-
ute in the placebo group (P<0.001).

major_points.text: Selected safety: elevated serum creatinine was more frequent with dronedarone than placebo (2.4% vs 0.2%, P=0.004).
major_points.quote:
there was a higher incidence of ele-
vated serum creatinine levels in the dronedarone
group than in the placebo group (2.4% vs. 0.2%,

criticisms.text: Not all episodes of recurrent arrhythmia were likely detected in these trials.
criticisms.quote:
As in many other trials examining the efficacy
of treatments for atrial fibrillation, it is likely that
we were not able to detect every episode of recur-
rent arrhythmia in our study patients.

criticisms.text: Efficacy cannot be reliably compared with amiodarone or sotalol based on these data because other studies may have differed markedly.
criticisms.quote:
the effectiveness of dronedarone in maintaining
sinus rhythm in atrial fibrillation cannot be reli-
ably compared with that of amiodarone or sotalol

criticisms.text: No direct comparison with amiodarone, so relative efficacy and adverse event rates vs amiodarone are uncertain.
criticisms.quote:
In neither of the trials did we directly compare
dronedarone with amiodarone. Therefore, we can-
not be certain that the efficacy of dronedarone is
similar to that of amiodarone

criticisms.text: Low rate of adverse events may be partly explained by short trial duration and limited pulmonary testing unless symptomatic.
